title: Classical Dynamics (lecture notes)
institution: University of Cambridge, DAMTP (Part II Mathematical Tripos)
description: Second course in classical mechanics for final-year mathematics undergraduates: Newtonian mechanics, the Lagrangian formulation (least action, constraints, Noether's theorem, applications, small oscillations), rigid bodies, and the Hamiltonian formulation. About 130 pages, four chapters, four problem sheets, plus an HTML version.
rightsNotes: The notes page states no licence and no copyright or reuse terms; the chapters and the full set 'can be downloaded here' for reading. Author copyright is assumed. Corniversity therefore treats the notes as reference-only: cite and link, do not copy or ingest.
The historic DAMTP address https://www.damtp.cam.ac.uk/user/tong/dynamics.html returned a 301 redirect to davidtong.org on 2026-10-30; the davidtong.org page is the live canonical location.
An expanded version exists as a commercial textbook (linked from the page as 'Classical Mechanics'); Corniversity does not require it.
